items.note: Fibrous capsule = outer surface of kidneys; not separate
items.custom_note: Fibrous capsule = the outer surface of the kidney, drawn as a thin shell over the posterior half (front half cut away so the interior stays visible).

items.note: Medial hilum on FJ3147/FJ3145
items.custom_note: Vertical slit on the concave medial border where the renal vein, artery and pelvis pass (located from the renal vessels).

items.note: Internal kidney layer; kidney is a single solid part
items.custom_note: Outer cortical band under the capsule. Hide the kidney (right-click it, or switch off the Urinary layer) to see this. Coronal-cut approximation: the kidney is one solid mesh in the donor, so its internal anatomy is built inside it and shown in the posterior half (the front half is cut away, as in a coronal section); the kidney itself is drawn see-through.

items.note: Neck where FJ3149 joins urethra FJ3148

items.note: Smooth muscle of bladder wall FJ3149; not separate

items.note: Internal triangle on posterior wall of FJ3149
items.custom_note: Smooth triangle on the inner posterior wall between the two ureteric orifices and the internal urethral orifice. Switch off the Urinary layer (or right-click the bladder) to look inside. The bladder is shown with the anterior wall of its right half cut away so the trigone and orifices inside are visible.

items.note: Opening at bladder neck (FJ3149 to urethra FJ3148)
items.custom_note: Opening of the bladder into the urethra at the bladder neck (apex of the trigone).

items.note: Smooth muscle at bladder neck of FJ3149; not separate
items.custom_note: Smooth-muscle collar around the bladder neck / start of the prostatic urethra (approximate; lies inside the top of the prostate).

items.note: Sphincter urethrae muscle absent; surrounds membranous part of urethra (bodyparts FJ3148)
items.custom_note: Sphincter urethrae: skeletal-muscle sleeve around the membranous urethra in the deep perineal pouch, just below the prostate apex.

items.note: Openings of ureters (FJ3146;FJ3144) at trigone corners of FJ3149
items.custom_note: Slit-like openings of the ureters at the superolateral corners of the trigone (placed where the ureters reach the bladder wall). Switch off the Urinary layer (or right-click the bladder) to look inside. The bladder is shown with the anterior wall of its right half cut away so the trigone and orifices inside are visible.

items.note: Segment of FJ3148 through urogenital diaphragm
items.custom_note: Short segment between the prostate apex and the bulb of the penis, passing through the external urethral sphincter.

items.note: Segment of FJ3148 within corpus spongiosum FJ3133
items.custom_note: Segment within the corpus spongiosum, from the bulb to the external urethral orifice.

items.note: Male meatus at tip of glans penis FJ3134; female not modeled
items.custom_note: Male meatus: vertical slit at the tip of the glans penis (the donor is male; female orifice not shown).

items.note: Branch of anterior division of internal iliac (SRC_Z_ANTERIOR_DIVISION_OF_INTERNAL_ILIAC_ARTERY_R/L, z-anatomy)
items.custom_note: From the patent part of the umbilical artery (anterior division of the internal iliac) forward along the pelvic side wall to the superolateral bladder, branching over its upper surface.

items.note: No pudendal nerve; accompanies SRC_Z_INTERNAL_PUDENDAL_ARTERY_R/L (z-anatomy)
items.custom_note: S2-S4: leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, crosses behind the ischial spine/sacrospinous ligament, re-enters through the lesser sciatic foramen and runs in the pudendal canal with the internal pudendal artery to the perineum.

items.note: Joint not modeled; midline between pubic bodies of the hip bones
items.custom_note: Secondary cartilaginous joint: the fibrocartilaginous interpubic disc filling the gap between the symphyseal surfaces of the two pubic bones.

items.note: Pubococcygeus, iliococcygeus, puborectalis R/L; z-anatomy lacks puborectalis
Male body; uterus not modeled
items.custom_note: Female pelvic organ built in the Z-Anatomy pelvis (the BodyParts3D donor is male): pear-shaped, anteverted and anteflexed in the true pelvis, cervix at the level of the ischial spines, body tilted forward over the (absent) bladder, fundus near the pelvic inlet.

items.note: Male body; vagina not modeled
items.custom_note: Fibromuscular canal (~8 cm) from the vaginal orifice in the vestibule (between urethral orifice and anus) upward and backward to the fornices around the cervix; built in the Z-Anatomy pelvis (H-shaped collapsed lumen approximated as a flattened tube).

items.note: Anal opening/canal not modeled; external anal sphincter surrounds it (below rectum, bodyparts FJ2571)
items.custom_note: Anal canal running down and back through the external anal sphincter from the anorectal junction to the anus (anal verge) in the perineum.
